title: Conscious perception is slow and late

statements.text: Early bottom-up sensory events before global ignition, in roughly the first 200 to 300 ms, contribute only to nonconscious percept construction and do not systematically distinguish seen from unseen stimuli.

sources.locator: Is Conscious Perception Slow and Late?
